shortDescription: Update yum configuration files for TripleO deployments.

options.name: arch
options.description: System architecture which the repos will be configure.

options.name: compose_url
options.description: URL that contains CentOS compose repositories.

options.name: dir_path
options.description: Absolute path of the directory that contains the configuration file to be changed.

options.name: disable_conflicting_variants
options.description: Disable all repos from the same directory that match variants' name.

options.name: disable_repos
options.description: List with file path of repos that should be disabled after successfully enabling all compose repos.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Change the yum repo or module to enabled or disabled. This options is ignored for yum global configuration.

options.name: file_path
options.description: Absolute path of the configuration file to be changed.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the repo or module to be changed. This options is mandatory only for repo and module types.

options.name: operation
options.description: Operation to be execute within a dnf module.

options.name: profile
options.description: Sets a module profile. This options is recommended when installing a module that doesn't have a default profile.

options.name: set_options
options.description: Dictionary with options to be updated. All dictionary values must be string or list of strings.

options.name: stream
options.description: Sets a module stream. This options is recommended when enabling a module that doesn't have a default stream.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of yum configuration to be changed.

options.name: variants
options.description: Repository variants that should be configured. If not provided, all available variants will be configured.
